answer: Each new agent must post a refundable stake, released gradually as randomly chosen established peers vouch for completed work. Reviewers who endorse a Sybil cluster lose part of their own stake, so fake identities cannot cheaply manufacture trust. A hidden beacon selects reviewers after submission, limiting collusion; a whisper of reputation alone earns nothing. The attacker must lock real capital, wait for release, and risk losses across linked identities, while honest newcomers recover their stake through useful work with a velvet-smooth path to trust.
